body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target's space provides concealment until the start of your next turn; suppress one Light Wound Condition's numerical penalties for that duration.

surges.html: The target may move 1 unit with the concealment following it.
Reduce its next incoming Necrotic or Psychic Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Phantom
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 2 Mana to enter Phantom Full Manifestation (FM-1P). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
